term.id: ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers)

text.id: ICANN adalah korporasi nirlaba kepentingan publik yang dibentuk pada 1998 untuk membantu mengoordinasikan nama dan nomor unik di Internet. Bylaws ICANN (anggaran dasar) menetapkan misinya: memastikan sistem pengidentifikasi unik Internet beroperasi secara stabil dan aman.
text.en: ICANN is a not-for-profit public-benefit corporation formed in 1998 to help coordinate the Internet's unique names and numbers. Its Bylaws set its mission: to ensure the stable and secure operation of the Internet's unique identifier systems.

citations.locator: Entry: Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN)
citations.quote: ICANN was formed in 1998 as a not-for-profit public-benefit corporation with a community of participants from all over the world.
to ensure the stable and secure operation of the Internet's unique identifier systems

text.id: Dalam model multistakeholder ICANN, kebijakan disusun dari bawah ke atas oleh pelaku bisnis, masyarakat sipil, komunitas teknis, akademisi, dan pengguna akhir, sementara pemerintah memberi nasihat. Bylaws mewajibkan ICANN memakai pendekatan ini.
text.en: In ICANN's multistakeholder model, policy is developed from the bottom up by business, civil society, the technical community, academia and end users, while governments advise. The Bylaws commit ICANN to this approach.

citations.quote: bottom-up, multistakeholder policy development processes that are led by the private sector (including business stakeholders, civil society, the technical community, academia, and end users), while duly taking into account the public policy advice of governments and public authorities.

text.id: Supporting Organization adalah badan yang diakui dalam Bylaws untuk menyusun rekomendasi kebijakan di satu bidang kerja ICANN. Ada tiga: ASO (nomor), ccNSO (domain kode negara), dan GNSO (domain generik).
text.en: A Supporting Organization is a body recognized in the Bylaws that develops policy recommendations for one area of ICANN's work. There are three: the ASO (numbers), the ccNSO (country-code domains) and the GNSO (generic domains).

citations.quote: A formally recognized body under the ICANN Bylaws that is charged with developing policy recommendations for a particular area of ICANN's operations.
Besides developing policy recommendations, SOs select directors for designated seats on the ICANN Board and participate in the nominating process to fill open Board positions.

text.id: Advisory Committee adalah badan yang diakui dalam Bylaws untuk memberi nasihat kepada Dewan (Direksi) ICANN tentang kebijakan dalam misi dan lingkup ICANN. Ada empat: ALAC, GAC, RSSAC, dan SSAC.
text.en: An Advisory Committee is a body recognized in the Bylaws that advises the ICANN Board on policies within ICANN's mission and scope. There are four: ALAC, GAC, RSSAC and SSAC.

citations.quote: A formally recognized body under the ICANN Bylaws that is charged with advising the ICANN Board on policies within ICANN’s mission and scope.

text.id: Proses pengembangan kebijakan (PDP) adalah prosedur yang ditetapkan dalam Bylaws, tempat Supporting Organization dan Advisory Committee menyusun dan menyempurnakan kebijakan. PDP mencakup komentar publik. Jika komunitas mencapai konsensus, Supporting Organization yang bersangkutan mengirim rekomendasinya ke Dewan untuk disetujui.
text.en: A policy development process is the procedure, specified in the Bylaws, through which Supporting Organizations and Advisory Committees develop and refine policy. It includes Public Comment, and when the community reaches consensus the Supporting Organization sends its recommendations to the Board for approval.

citations.quote: The process, specified in the ICANN Bylaws, through which ICANN’s Supporting Organizations and Advisory Committees develop and refine policies within ICANN’s mission and scope.
When the community achieves consensus, the relevant Supporting Organization submits the policy recommendations to the ICANN Board for approval.

term.id: Domain tingkat atas generik (generic top-level domain)

text.id: gTLD adalah domain tingkat atas dalam kelas generik, yang mencakup domain serba guna seperti .com, .net, .edu, dan .org. Kelas ini juga mencakup domain dari New gTLD Program, misalnya .pizza.
text.en: A gTLD is a top-level domain in the generic class, which includes general-purpose domains such as .com, .net, .edu and .org. It also includes domains from the New gTLD Program, such as .pizza.

citations.quote: The class of top-level domains that includes general-purpose domains such as .com, .net, .edu, and .org.
This class also includes domains associated with the New Generic Top-Level Domains Program

term.id: Domain tingkat atas kode negara (country code top-level domain)

text.id: ccTLD adalah domain tingkat atas yang dicadangkan untuk negara, wilayah, atau lokasi geografis dalam daftar ISO 3166-1, misalnya .jp untuk Jepang. Setiap ccTLD dikelola secara lokal, sehingga aturan pendaftarannya berbeda-beda.
text.en: A ccTLD is a top-level domain reserved for a country, territory or geographic location listed in ISO 3166-1, such as .jp for Japan. Each ccTLD is managed locally, so registration rules differ from one to another.

citations.quote: The class of top-level domains reserved for use by countries, territories, and geographical locations identified in the ISO 3166-1 Country Codes list.
Because ccTLDs are managed locally, the rules and policies for registering domain names vary across ccTLDs.

text.id: TLD adalah bagian paling akhir dari nama domain, di puncak hierarki penamaan Domain Name System. Pada icann.org, TLD-nya adalah org. TLD terbagi dua kelas: generik (gTLD) dan kode negara (ccTLD).
text.en: A TLD is the last part of a domain name, at the top of the Domain Name System's naming hierarchy. In icann.org, the TLD is org. TLDs fall into two classes: generic (gTLD) and country code (ccTLD).

citations.quote: A domain at the top of the naming hierarchy of the Domain Name System. In a domain name, the TLD appears after the second-level domain.
in the domain name icann.org, the characters org identify the TLD.

text.id: DNS memungkinkan orang memakai nama domain yang mudah diingat sebagai ganti alamat IP numerik sebuah komputer. Misalnya, kamu mengetik icann.org, bukan 192.0.43.7.
text.en: The DNS lets people use a familiar domain name instead of the numeric IP address of a computer. For example, you type icann.org instead of 192.0.43.7.

citations.quote: The DNS makes using the Internet easier by allowing a familiar string of letters - the domain name - to be used instead of the arcane IP address.

text.id: DNSSEC adalah teknologi yang membantu mengamankan pencarian nama domain dengan menambahkan rantai tanda tangan digital ke proses pencarian. Dengan DNSSEC, resolver dapat memeriksa bahwa jawaban berasal dari server DNS yang terautentikasi, sehingga penyerang tidak bisa mengarahkan pengguna ke situs palsu.
text.en: DNSSEC is a technology that helps secure domain name lookups by adding a chain of digital signatures to the lookup process. It lets resolvers check that an answer came from an authenticated DNS server, which prevents attackers from sending users to deceptive websites.

citations.locator: Entry: Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC)
citations.quote: A technology that helps secure domain name lookups by incorporating a chain of digital signatures into the lookup process.

citations.locator: Entry: Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC)
citations.quote: By accepting only authenticated query results, resolvers can prevent attackers from hijacking the lookup process and directing Internet users to deceptive websites.

text.id: Menurut definisi ICANN, DNS Abuse mencakup lima jenis kerugian: botnet, malware, pharming, phishing, dan spam bila spam menjadi sarana penyebar keempat jenis lainnya. Dewan ICANN mengakui kumpulan ini, dan isinya sejalan dengan kewajiban yang ditambahkan ke kontrak registrar dan registry pada April 2024.
text.en: As ICANN defines it, DNS Abuse means five kinds of harm: botnets, malware, pharming, phishing, and spam when spam delivers the other four. The ICANN Board recognized this set, and it matches obligations added to registrar and registry contracts in April 2024.

citations.locator: Entry: Domain Name System Abuse (DNS Abuse)
citations.quote: DNS Abuse, as defined by ICANN, refers to: 1. botnets 2. malware 3. pharming 4. phishing 5. spam (when spam serves as a delivery mechanism for the forms of DNS Abuse listed)

citations.locator: Entry: Domain Name System Abuse (DNS Abuse)
citations.quote: aligns with the 5 April 2024 amendments to the Registrar Accreditation Agreement and the Base Generic Top-Level Domain Registry Agreement

text.id: Root server adalah name server otoritatif yang menjawab pertanyaan tentang isi root zone. Semua root server diharapkan memegang edisi root zone yang terbaru.
text.en: A root server is an authoritative name server that answers queries about the contents of the root zone. Root servers are expected to hold the current edition of the root zone.

citations.quote: An authoritative name server that responds to queries about the contents of the root zone.
All root servers are expected to have (and respond to queries about) the current edition of the root zone.

text.id: Root zone adalah puncak hierarki DNS dan memuat semua informasi yang diperlukan untuk menemukan domain tingkat atas. IANA mencatat delegasi TLD, seperti .edu atau .in, di dalamnya.
text.en: The root zone is the top of the DNS hierarchy and holds all the information needed to find top-level domains. IANA records the delegations of TLDs, such as .edu or .in, in it.

citations.quote: The top of the Domain Name System hierarchy. The root zone contains all the information needed to find top-level domains.
The Domain Name System (DNS) root zone is the highest-level of the naming hierarchy, principally composed of delegations of top-level domains (such as .edu or .in).

text.id: Fungsi IANA mengoordinasikan pengidentifikasi dan kode unik yang menjaga Internet tetap berjalan. Cakupannya: sumber daya nomor Internet, root zone DNS, dan registri kode serta nomor yang dipakai protokol Internet. Pelaksananya adalah Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), afiliasi ICANN.
text.en: The IANA functions coordinate the unique identifiers and codes that keep the Internet running. They cover Internet number resources, the DNS root zone, and the registries of codes and numbers used in Internet protocols. Public Technical Identifiers (PTI), an ICANN affiliate, performs them.

citations.locator: Entry: Internet Assigned Numbers Authority functions (IANA functions)
citations.quote: IANA functions include management of Internet number resources, management of the Domain Name System root zone, and maintenance of the authoritative registries for many of the codes and numbers used in the Internet protocols.

citations.locator: Entry: Internet Assigned Numbers Authority functions (IANA functions)
citations.quote: The IANA functions are performed by Public Technical Identifiers, an affiliate of ICANN.

text.id: Alamat IP adalah nilai numerik yang mengidentifikasi sebuah perangkat di Internet secara unik. Alamat IPv4 panjangnya 32 bit, misalnya 192.0.32.7. Alamat IPv6 panjangnya 128 bit, misalnya 2620:0:2d0:200::7.
text.en: An IP address is a numeric value that uniquely identifies a device attached to the Internet. IPv4 addresses are 32 bits long, for example 192.0.32.7. IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long, for example 2620:0:2d0:200::7.

citations.quote: A numeric value that uniquely identifies a device attached to the Internet.
Internet Protocol version 4 (IPv4) addresses have a length of 32 bits
Internet Protocol version 6 (IPv6) addresses have a length of 128 bits

text.id: ASN adalah pengenal unik global untuk sebuah sistem otonom, yaitu kumpulan jaringan IP yang dioperasikan satu atau lebih operator jaringan. Router memakai ASN untuk meneruskan pesan antarsistem otonom, mirip kode pos yang mengarahkan surat. ASN dialokasikan kepada operator jaringan oleh Regional Internet Registry.
text.en: An ASN is a globally unique identifier for an autonomous system, which is a collection of IP networks run by one or more network operators. Routers use ASNs to pass messages between autonomous systems, much as postal codes route mail. Regional Internet Registries allocate ASNs to network operators.

citations.quote: A globally unique identifier given to an autonomous system (AS). An AS is a collection of Internet Protocol (IP) networks operated by one or more network operators.
ASNs are allocated to network operators by Regional Internet Registries.

text.id: Registry adalah basis data induk otoritatif dari nama domain yang terdaftar di sebuah domain tingkat atas. Setiap TLD punya satu registry, dan DNS merujuknya untuk menemukan name server bagi setiap domain di TLD itu.
text.en: A registry is the authoritative master database of the domain names registered in a top-level domain. Each TLD has one, and the DNS consults it to find the name servers for any domain in that TLD.

citations.quote: An authoritative master database of the domain names registered in a top-level domain (TLD).
The Domain Name System consults the TLD registry to obtain the authoritative name servers for the domain names registered in that TLD.

text.id: Registrar adalah organisasi tempat individu dan entitas (registrant) mendaftarkan nama domain. Registrar memeriksa apakah nama itu memenuhi persyaratan registry, lalu mengirimkannya ke operator registry. Registrar yang menandatangani Registrar Accreditation Agreement dengan ICANN disebut ICANN-accredited registrar.
text.en: A registrar is an organization through which individuals and entities (registrants) register domain names. It checks that the name meets registry requirements and submits it to the registry operator. A registrar with a Registrar Accreditation Agreement with ICANN is called an ICANN-accredited registrar.

citations.quote: An organization through which individuals and entities (registrants) register domain names.
A registrar that has entered into a Registrar Accreditation Agreement with ICANN is referred to as an ICANN-accredited registrar.

text.id: At-Large adalah bagian komunitas ICANN yang terdiri dari pengguna Internet individu. Komite penasihatnya adalah ALAC, dan para penggunanya diorganisasi lewat At-Large Structure ke dalam lima Regional At-Large Organization.
text.en: At-Large is the part of the ICANN community made up of individual Internet users. Its advisory committee is the ALAC, and its users are organized through At-Large Structures into five Regional At-Large Organizations.

citations.quote: The At-Large Advisory Committee (" At-Large Advisory Committee " or " ALAC ") is the primary organizational home within ICANN for individual Internet users.
The ICANN Bylaws recognize five Regional At-Large Organizations

text.id: RALO adalah forum utama dan titik koordinasi masukan publik kepada ICANN dari satu kawasan geografis. Bylaws mengakui lima RALO: AFRALO, APRALO, EURALO, LACRALO, dan NARALO. Masing-masing memilih pimpinan dan menetapkan aturan kerjanya sendiri.
text.en: A RALO is the main forum and coordination point for public input to ICANN from one geographic region. The Bylaws recognize five: AFRALO, APRALO, EURALO, LACRALO and NARALO. Each elects its own leaders and sets its own operating rules.

citations.quote: An organization that serves as the main forum and coordination point for public input to ICANN for a particular geographic region.
Each RALO elects its leadership and defines its own operating rules.

text.id: Dalam istilah ICANN, pengguna Internet individu berpartisipasi sebagai pribadi, bukan atas nama perusahaan atau pemerintah. ALAC adalah rumah organisasi utama mereka di ICANN.
text.en: In ICANN terms, an individual Internet user takes part as a private person, not on behalf of a company or government. The ALAC is ICANN's primary organizational home for them.

citations.quote: The role of the ALAC shall be to consider and provide advice on the activities of ICANN, insofar as they relate to the interests of individual Internet users.

text.id: Nasihat adalah temuan dan rekomendasi yang diberikan sebuah Advisory Committee kepada Dewan ICANN. Advisory Committee tidak punya kewenangan hukum untuk bertindak atas nama ICANN, jadi nasihat adalah masukan yang dipertimbangkan Dewan, bukan keputusan.
text.en: Advice is the findings and recommendations an Advisory Committee gives the ICANN Board. Advisory Committees have no legal authority to act for ICANN, so advice is input the Board considers, not a decision.

citations.quote: Advisory Committees shall have no legal authority to act for ICANN, but shall report their findings and recommendations to the Board.

text.id: Nasihat GAC adalah nasihat tentang urusan kebijakan publik dari Governmental Advisory Committee. Dewan wajib mempertimbangkannya dengan semestinya. Jika GAC menyepakatinya secara konsensus, Dewan hanya dapat menolaknya dengan suara sedikitnya 60% dari Dewan.
text.en: GAC Advice is advice on public policy matters from the Governmental Advisory Committee. The Board must take it duly into account. If the GAC adopts it by consensus, the Board can reject it only by a vote of at least 60% of the Board.

citations.quote: The advice of the Governmental Advisory Committee on public policy matters shall be duly taken into account, both in the formulation and adoption of policies.
may only be rejected by a vote of no less than 60% of the Board

text.id: Komentar publik adalah mekanisme yang memberi komunitas ICANN dan pihak lain kesempatan menyampaikan masukan dan tanggapan. Mekanisme ini dipakai dalam proses pengembangan kebijakan, dan untuk memandu pekerjaan implementasi, tinjauan, serta kegiatan operasional ICANN org.
text.en: Public Comment is a mechanism that lets the ICANN community and others give input and feedback. It is used in the policy development process and to guide implementation work, reviews and operations of ICANN org.

citations.quote: A mechanism that gives the ICANN community and other stakeholders an opportunity to provide input and feedback.
Public Comment is also used to guide implementation work, reviews, and operational activities of the ICANN organization.

text.id: Resolusi Dewan adalah keputusan formal yang disahkan Dewan ICANN dalam rapat. Bylaws mewajibkan resolusi diumumkan di situs ICANN paling lambat akhir hari kerja kedua setelah rapat, kecuali untuk hal-hal seperti urusan kepegawaian atau hukum.
text.en: A Board resolution is a formal decision passed by the ICANN Board at a meeting. The Bylaws require resolutions to be published on the ICANN website by the end of the second business day after the meeting, except for matters such as personnel or legal issues.

citations.quote: any resolutions passed by the Board at that meeting shall be made publicly available on the Website
actions relating to personnel or employment matters, legal matters

text.id: IDN adalah nama domain dengan sedikitnya satu label yang memuat karakter selain huruf ASCII, angka, atau tanda hubung. Karena IDN mendukung Unicode, nama domain dapat memakai karakter bahasa dan aksara lokal, misalnya Hangul.
text.en: An IDN is a domain name with at least one label containing characters other than ASCII letters, digits or hyphens. Because IDNs support Unicode, they can use the characters of local languages and scripts, such as Hangul.

citations.quote: A domain name in which one or more of its labels contain characters other than ASCII letters, digits, or hyphens.
Because IDNs support the use of Unicode characters, they can include characters from local languages and scripts.

text.id: Bylaws ICANN (anggaran dasar) adalah aturan tata kelola ICANN. Pasal 1 menetapkan misinya, dan Bylaws juga mengatur Dewan, Supporting Organization, Advisory Committee, serta Empowered Community. Perubahan standar memerlukan dua pertiga suara seluruh anggota Dewan setelah komentar publik.
text.en: The Bylaws are ICANN's governing rules. They set its mission in Article 1 and also define the Board, the Supporting Organizations, the Advisory Committees and the Empowered Community. A standard amendment needs a two-thirds vote of all Directors after public comment.

citations.quote: The mission of the Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers
these Bylaws may be altered, amended, or repealed and new Bylaws adopted only upon approval by a two-thirds vote of all Directors
a draft of the Standard Bylaw Amendment shall be posted on the Website and shall be subject to public comment

text.id: RIR adalah salah satu dari lima registri yang mengalokasikan sumber daya alamat IP di suatu kawasan dunia. Operator jaringan mengajukan permohonan sumber daya itu ke RIR di kawasannya.
text.en: An RIR is one of five registries that allocate IP address resources within a region of the world. Network operators apply to their RIR for these resources.

citations.quote: One of the five registries responsible for the allocation of Internet Protocol (IP) address resources within a particular region of the world.
Network operators apply to their RIR for these resources.

text.id: NomCom adalah badan ICANN yang mengisi sejumlah posisi di Dewan, ALAC, serta Council ccNSO dan GNSO. NomCom memiliki 18 delegasi dengan hak suara: satu dari masing-masing Address Council ASO, Council ccNSO, GAC, SSAC, RSSAC, dan IETF, lima dari ALAC, dan tujuh dari GNSO. Untuk Dewan, NomCom menominasikan delapan Direktur, yang kemudian ditetapkan oleh Empowered Community.
text.en: The NomCom is the ICANN body that fills a number of positions on the Board, the ALAC and the ccNSO and GNSO Councils. It has 18 voting delegates: one each from the ASO Address Council, the ccNSO Council, the GAC, the SSAC, the RSSAC and the IETF, five from the ALAC and seven from the GNSO. For the Board, it nominates eight Directors, whom the Empowered Community designates.

citations.quote: One voting delegate each selected by the following entities:
Five voting delegates selected by the At-Large Advisory Committee
Seven voting delegates to the Nominating Committee shall be selected from the Generic Names Supporting Organization
Eight Directors nominated by the Nominating Committee to be designated as Directors by the EC.

text.id: Empowered Community adalah asosiasi nirlaba berdasarkan hukum California yang memegang kewenangan formal komunitas atas ICANN. Lima Decisional Participant-nya adalah tiga SO, ALAC, dan GAC, dan Bylaws memberinya sembilan kewenangan untuk mengangkat keberatan atas tindakan Dewan atau ICANN org.
text.en: The Empowered Community is a nonprofit association under California law that holds the community's formal powers over ICANN. Its five Decisional Participants are the three SOs, the ALAC and the GAC, and the Bylaws give it nine powers to raise concerns about Board or ICANN org actions.

citations.quote: shall be a nonprofit association formed under the laws of the State of California
The Empowered Community is composed of five Decisional Participants: ICANN’s three Supporting Organizations, the At-Large Advisory Committee, and the Governmental Advisory Committee.
This mechanism provides the Empowered Community with nine powers it can use to raise concerns regarding an action or inaction taken by the ICANN Board or the ICANN organization.

text.id: Stakeholder group (kelompok pemangku kepentingan) adalah badan di dalam GNSO yang mewakili satu segmen komunitas GNSO dan memegang kursi tertentu di Council GNSO. Ada empat: Registry, Registrar, Commercial, dan Non-Commercial Stakeholder Group.
text.en: A stakeholder group is a body within the GNSO that represents one segment of the GNSO community and holds designated seats on the GNSO Council. There are four: the Registry, Registrar, Commercial and Non-Commercial Stakeholder Groups.

citations.quote: A formally recognized body within the Generic Names Supporting Organization (GNSO) that represents a specific segment of the GNSO community.
The GNSO has four stakeholder groups

text.id: Program Fellowship ICANN membantu orang dari komunitas yang kurang terlayani dan kurang terwakili menjadi peserta aktif di ICANN. Fellow mendapat mentor, pelatihan, dan bantuan perjalanan untuk menghadiri ICANN Public Meeting. Pelamar harus berusia minimal 21 tahun, dan setiap pertemuan punya putaran pendaftaran sendiri.
text.en: The ICANN Fellowship Program helps people from underserved and underrepresented communities become active participants in ICANN. Fellows get a mentor, training and travel assistance for an ICANN Public Meeting. Applicants must be at least 21, and a separate application round opens for each meeting.

citations.quote: The goal of the ICANN Fellowship Program is to strengthen the representation of the multistakeholder model by fostering opportunities for individuals from underserved and underrepresented communities to become active participants in the ICANN community.
Travel assistance to attend the meeting is also provided.
Be at least 21 years of age by the time of the application submission
Opening of application round Closing of application round Announcement of selected Fellows

text.id: NextGen@ICANN adalah program anak muda ICANN untuk mahasiswa berusia 18 sampai 30 tahun yang tinggal dan belajar di kawasan tempat pertemuan ICANN berikutnya digelar. Mahasiswa terpilih mendapat pembinaan, bimbingan, dan dukungan perjalanan untuk menghadiri pertemuan. Setiap pertemuan punya putaran pendaftaran sendiri.
text.en: NextGen@ICANN is ICANN's youth program for students aged 18 to 30 who live and study in the region of an upcoming ICANN meeting. Selected students get coaching, guidance and travel support to attend the meeting. A separate application round opens for each meeting.

citations.quote: Enrolled as an undergraduate, graduate, or doctoral student. Between the ages of 18 and 30 at the time of the ICANN meeting.
Currently living and studying in the region of the respective ICANN meeting.
we will provide selected students from the ICANN meeting region with coaching, guidance, and travel support
Opening of Application Round Closing of Application Round Announcement of Selected NextGen

term.id: Uniform Domain Name Dispute Resolution Policy (UDRP)
term.en: Uniform Domain Name Dispute Resolution Policy

text.id: UDRP adalah kebijakan untuk menyelesaikan sengketa atas dugaan pendaftaran nama domain yang menyalahgunakan hak, misalnya cybersquatting. Pemegang merek dagang dapat mengajukan keluhan ke penyedia layanan penyelesaian sengketa yang disetujui untuk memulai proses administratif yang dipercepat.
text.en: The UDRP is a policy for resolving disputes over alleged abusive registrations of domain names, such as cybersquatting. A trademark holder can file a complaint with an approved dispute resolution service provider to start an expedited administrative proceeding.

citations.locator: Entry: Uniform Domain Name Dispute Resolution Policy (UDRP)
citations.quote: A policy for resolving disputes arising from alleged abusive registrations of domain names (for example, cybersquatting).

citations.locator: Entry: Uniform Domain Name Dispute Resolution Policy (UDRP)
citations.quote: The UDRP allows trademark holders to initiate expedited administrative proceedings by filing a complaint with an approved Dispute Resolution Service Provider.
